id: \rYellow: My name is Yellow. I've received psychic abilities from here that give me the ability to read the emotions of Pokémon and heal their wounds.
en: \rYellow: My name is Yellow. I've received psychic abilities from here that give me the ability to read the emotions of Pokémon and heal their wounds.
it: \rYellow: Mi chiamo Yellow. Qui ho ricevuto poteri psichici che mi permettono di leggere le emozioni dei Pokémon e di curarne le ferite.

id: \rBecause of that I've been given the title Healer.
en: \rBecause of that I've been given the title Healer.
it: \rPer questo mi è stato conferito il titolo di Guaritrice.

id: \rYellow: You did a good job. I'm glad everyone is okay.
en: \rYellow: You did a good job. I'm glad everyone is okay.
it: \rYellow: Sei stato bravo. Sono contenta che stiano tutti bene.
